questions.question: 12 men can complete a work in 18 days. After 6 days 4 men leave. The remaining work is finished by the rest in
questions.explanation: Total = 216 man-days. 72 done, 144 left. 8 men take 144 ÷ 8 = 18 days.

questions.question: A can do a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. They work on alternate days, A first. The job is finished in
questions.explanation: A pair of days does 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36. 7 pairs (14 days) do 35/36. A finishes the last 1/36 on day 15.

questions.question: 3 men or 5 women can do a work in 15 days. 6 men and 5 women can do it in
questions.explanation: 3 men = 5 women, so 6 men = 10 women. 6 men and 5 women = 15 women. 5 women take 15 days, so 15 women take 5 days.

questions.question: A is twice as good a worker as B and together they finish a job in 18 days. A alone would take
questions.explanation: Rates A = 2x, B = x; 3x = 1/18, so x = 1/54 and A = 1/27. A takes 27 days.

questions.explanation: Efficiency ratio A : B = 5 : 4, so the times are in the ratio 4 : 5. A = 20 × 4/5 = 16 days.

questions.question: A and B can finish a job in 30 and 20 days. They start together but A leaves 5 days before the job is finished. The job takes
questions.explanation: Let the time be t. t/20 + (t − 5)/30 = 1 gives 3t + 2t − 10 = 60, so t = 14.

questions.question: A and B together can do a work in 6 days. A alone takes 5 days less than B alone. A alone takes
questions.explanation: Let A = x and B = x + 5. 1/x + 1/(x + 5) = 1/6 gives x² − 7x − 30 = 0, so x = 10.

questions.question: A can do 1/3 of a work in 4 days and B can do 1/4 of it in 6 days. Together they can do the whole work in
questions.explanation: A alone = 12 days and B alone = 24 days. 1/12 + 1/24 = 1/8, so 8 days.

questions.question: 15 men can complete a work in 20 days. After 10 days, 5 men leave. The total time taken to complete the work is
questions.explanation: Total = 300 man-days. 150 done in 10 days. 10 men do the remaining 150 in 15 days. Total 25 days.

questions.explanation: A takes x and B takes 3x, with 3x − x = 24, so x = 12 and B = 36. 1/12 + 1/36 = 1/9, so 9 days.
